acceptance_criteria.text: Generic Classroom capstone submissions carry the exact authored stage context into CourseProgress completion and persist stage evidence through the canonical envelope owner.
Evaluation selects the authored stage prompt and rubric deterministically and fails closed for missing or mismatched stage context.
Academic Record capstone and module assessment projections agree with authoritative CourseProgress after valid and invalid submissions.
Public-neutral tests cover missing stage context, stage-specific evaluation, evidence persistence, retry, and Academic Record projection without private-course content.
